fnol_text: My name is Anika Yilmaz and I live at 353 Juniper Drive, Dover, DE 19923. You can reach me on (555) 482-3585 or anika.yilmaz@example.com. On 7 April 2024 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2023-00122. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Yilmaz on (555) 482-3585 to acknowledge the claim. Anika confirmed the loss date as 7 April 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Nikhil Wojcik gave a statement by phone.
Anika sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
